blocks.prompt: 13 (i) There are 6 men and 8 women members of a club. how many committees of seven can be formed? (i) 3 women
blocks.explanation:
7 members ki committee jis mein theek 3 auratein (women) hon, yani baqi \(7 - 3 = 4\) mard (men).
Find kya karna hai? Aisi committees ki tadaad; tarteeb se farq nahi parta.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{3} \times {}^{6}C_{4}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 men, 8 women; 7 ki committee jis mein 3 women.
Humein find karna hai: committees ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: 8 women mein se 3, aur 6 men mein se 4. Dono kaam ek saath hone hain, is liye dono combinations ko multiply karenge. Sawal mein men ka zikr nahi, lekin committee 7 ki hai, is liye baqi 4 seats men ki hain.

Women chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{3} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\]
Kyun: 8 women mein se 3 chunni hain; \(3! = 6\) upar ke 6 ko cancel karta hai.

Men chunein
\[{}^{6}C_{4} = {}^{6}C_{2} = \dfrac{6 \cdot 5}{2} = 15\]
Kyun: Baqi 4 seats men se bharni hain. 6 mein se 4 lena aur 2 chhorna barabar hai, is liye chhota hisaab \({}^{6}C_{2}\) kiya.

Multiply karein
\[56 \times 15 = 840\]
Kyun: Har women wala group har men wale group ke saath committee bana sakta hai.
Dhyan dein: Sirf \({}^{8}C_{3}\) likh kar ruk jana ghalat hai; men ki seats bhi bharni hain.

Tasdeeq
\[3 + 4 = 7 \text{ members}\]
\[840 \div 15 = 56 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Committee ka size sahi hai aur multiplication ulta divide karne par sahi nikla.

blocks.prompt: 13 (ii) There are 6 men and 8 women members of a club. how many committees of seven can be formed? (ii) at the most 3 women
blocks.explanation:
"At the most 3 women" (zyada se zyada 3 auratein) ka matlab hai 0, 1, 2 ya 3 women; baqi seats men bharenge.
Find kya karna hai? Tamam jaiz suraton ki committees ka jama.
Plan: har surat mein \({}^{8}C_{w} \times {}^{6}C_{7-w}\) nikalein, phir sab jama karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 men, 8 women; 7 ki committee jis mein zyada se zyada 3 women.
Humein find karna hai: committees ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Pehle suraton (cases) ki list banayein, \(w\) = women ki tadaad. Ek committee ek waqt mein sirf ek surat mein aati hai (ya 1 woman, ya 2), is liye cases ko jama karte hain. List pehle banane se koi surat chhoot nahi jati.

Surat \(w = 0\): 7 men
\[{}^{6}C_{7} = 0\]
Kyun: Club mein sirf 6 men hain, 7 men ki committee mumkin hi nahi. Yeh surat 0 deti hai, lekin isay list mein likhna zaroori hai taake pata ho ke humne isay socha.

Surat \(w = 1\): 1 woman, 6 men
\[{}^{8}C_{1} \times {}^{6}C_{6} = 8 \times 1 = 8\]
Kyun: 1 woman 8 tareeqon se, aur saare 6 men lene ka sirf 1 tareeqa.

Surat \(w = 3\): 3 women, 4 men
\[{}^{8}C_{3} \times {}^{6}C_{4} = 56 \times 15 = 840\]
Kyun: Yeh wahi hai jo part (i) mein nikala tha, dobara hisaab ki zaroorat nahi.

Cases jama karein
\[0 + 8 + 168 + 840 = 1016\]
Kyun: "At the most" ka matlab hai yeh surat YA woh surat, aur "ya" (OR) par jama hota hai.
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(w = 3\) wala case likh kar 840 jawab dena aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{all committees} = {}^{14}C_{7} = 3432\]
\[\text{4 or more women} = 1400 + 840 + 168 + 8 = 2416\]
\[1016 + 2416 = 3432 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har committee mein ya to zyada se zyada 3 women hain ya kam az kam 4. Dono hisson ka jama kul committees ke barabar aaya, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 13 (iii) There are 6 men and 8 women members of a club. how many committees of seven can be formed? (iii) at least 5 women?
blocks.explanation:
"At least 5 women" (kam az kam 5 auratein) ka matlab hai 5, 6 ya 7 women; baqi seats men ki.
Find kya karna hai? In suraton ki committees ka jama.
Plan: \(w = 5, 6, 7\) ke liye \({}^{8}C_{w} \times {}^{6}C_{7-w}\) nikal kar jama karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 men, 8 women; 7 ki committee jis mein kam az kam 5 women.
Humein find karna hai: committees ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Suraton ki list \(w = 5, 6, 7\) banayein aur jama karein. Dhyan rahe ke list 7 tak jati hai, kyunke committee mein 7 hi log hain aur women 8 hain, is liye saari 7 seats women le sakti hain.

Surat \(w = 5\): 5 women, 2 men
\[{}^{8}C_{5} \times {}^{6}C_{2} = 56 \times 15 = 840\]
Kyun: \({}^{8}C_{5} = {}^{8}C_{3} = 56\) aur \({}^{6}C_{2} = 15\). Complementary rule se dono ka hisaab chhota ho gaya.

Surat \(w = 7\): 7 women, koi man nahi
\[{}^{8}C_{7} \times {}^{6}C_{0} = 8 \times 1 = 8\]
Kyun: \({}^{8}C_{7} = {}^{8}C_{1} = 8\) (7 lena yani 1 chhorna) aur \({}^{6}C_{0} = 1\). Yeh surat mumkin hai kyunke women 8 hain.
Dhyan dein: Yahi surat bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

Cases jama karein
\[840 + 168 + 8 = 1016\]
Kyun: "At least" bhi suraton ko "ya" se jorta hai, is liye jama.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{at most 4 women} = 0 + 8 + 168 + 840 + 1400 = 2416\]
\[1016 + 2416 = 3432 = {}^{14}C_{7} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Kam az kam 5 women wali aur zyada se zyada 4 women wali committees mil kar saari committees banti hain (\({}^{14}C_{7} = 3432\)). Jama barabar aaya, is liye 1016 sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (iii) ke liye answer key 1008 likhti hai. Yeh sirf \(840 + 168\) hai: is mein 7 women aur koi man nahi wali surat (\({}^{8}C_{7} \times {}^{6}C_{0} = 8\)) chhoot gayi. Sahi jawab \(840 + 168 + 8 = 1016\) hai.
